title: It's Warm
author: Dell Harrow, crew chief
pages: Not a satellite. The plating is warm to the touch, even at night, and the torch slides off it like water off wax. Rudy says it hums in his back teeth.
We got a seam open on the north side. Inside it's all ribs and coils, packed like a beehive. The coils come out easy. Too easy.
